name: smda-automation
description: Tier-3 setup skill for State-Machine-Driven Automation, packaged for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Set up the repo context harness and SMDA config against the SMDA Scheduler product.
interface.longDescription: Two setup skills: setup-codex-development-harness builds the repo context substrate (tracker contract, roadmap, work-ledger, index/routing, bootloader block); setup-smda-automation wires the repo-local SMDA operating model (config, routing, gates) to the SMDA Scheduler product hosted in this repo. Config surface only: it never vendors engine, adapter, schema, or report code into the target repo.
defaultPrompt: Set up SMDA automation in this repo against the SMDA Scheduler product.
Refresh the SMDA config and check it against the product contracts.
